title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
THE REUNION OF AUGUST 6 AND 7, 1938

ASSEMBLY AND REGISTRATION.—All plans worked out almost to the mark of perfection, and on Saturday morning, August 6, 1938, a large group of ex-students and friends of old Savoy College arrived at the new Halsell Gymnasium in Savoy for the informal greeting time which was scheduled to extend to the two o'clock business meeting hour.

A news reporter described the morning's activities thus:

Remarking on the enthusiasm of the celebrants one observer said: "Why, they went on like a school reunion!"

Handshakes were warm and kisses were noted in profusion. Eyes sparkled with memories renewed, friendships of bygone years.*

Much of the morning was spent in enjoying the exhibit of old photographs, diplomas, textbooks, autograph albums, and other cherished College mementos. At noon the registration began under the supervision of Mr. Lew Reynolds, former professor of music and leadership in the College. The hand-made frontispiece for the list of registrants shown by photostats in this chapter is a work of art done by Mr. Reynolds himself for the occasion at the author's request.**

THE FORMATION OF A PERMANENT EX-STUDENTS' ASSOCIATION.—From the standpoint of long-time perpetuation of interest in the old Savoy College tradition, the most significant activity of the whole reunion period was the crystallization of the reunion occasion into a permanent association of ex-students and the provision for annual reunions in the future. The complete official minutes are herewith given. The official minutes of the afternoon business session kept by Mrs. J. B. May, the secretary of the General Committee on the Reunion:
